## 2025

This game is a really hard-fought draw against Matt Ball, an acclaimed chess author. I was playing Board 2 in the Herts & District final (Welwyn-Hatfield vs St Albans) and was under pressure the whole game. The draw was critical for our Welwyn-Hatfield to win the match and the cup.
